replacement.title: Direct Post-Publication Link Reporting
replacement.definition: Send the published Instagram Reel link directly to the client after publication.

patches.decision_note: Directly reporting the live Reel link is independently requested and fulfilled, and does not establish that the date and link were recorded on the designated Notion card.

value_updates.permitted_source_collection: Any YouTube video may be selected

patches.decision_note: The new client instruction replaces the prior Arden-only source collection; updating the existing key avoids leaving contradictory source-selection attributes.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: For the rest of the clips, each one must deliver a complete lesson instead of cutting it off halfway. Don't make them all 45 sec; aim for 70-85 seconde.

execution.observed_behavior: After revised work was submitted, the client reports that the remaining clips were still approximately 45 seconds rather than the required 70-to-85-second duration.

patches.decision_note: This is post-revision persistence affecting multiple remaining clips, adding a distinct duration failure beyond the earlier single 45-second clip.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: The only correction left is the text placement; the clips are good otherwise. Keep the text fixed in one place like in the example I sent, rather than moving it up and down.

execution.observed_behavior: After the freelancer reported removing the black text outline, the client reviewed the clips and stated that caption placement was the only correction remaining.

patches.decision_note: This is the first concrete post-fix verification of the disallowed black text effect.
Message 280 may add a duration acceptance rule or runtime failure for clips under 70 seconds, but its raw text and sufficient context are not supplied for a safe Event patch.
Message 303 appears to change the minimum approved-clip posting obligation under REQ_INSTAGRAM_ROLLOUT_CADENCE, but the raw source text is unavailable for an exact MODIFY.

The one-clip delivery report may be a runtime failure for assigned-batch or monthly output and may accompany engagement termination; raw context is required to determine the correct target and lifecycle impact.
